items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: I had a dear friend in Syracuse named Chris Powell.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was really mixing almost like classical music with the swing type thing.

But another nice man was Count Basie. He was just so relaxed. I had a dear friend in Syracuse named Chris Powell. And Chris was a drummer. And his main claim to fame was he was the original band that Clifford Brown came out of. And Clifford was so great, oh.
Oh yeah. What a tragedy that —
